note: Forest, old fields and small fishing ponds south of Unionville. MDC marks five camping sites, each beside a small gravel parking lot on a different county road around the area; this one is on 324th Road on the east side. No amenities. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: five map/GIS-designated camping sites, each beside its own small lot (pin = GIS 538 beside lot 789 on 324th Rd). Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights now manual. Pin fine; phone matches; not waterfront kept; no split (each spot is a single small lot).
flags: INCLUSION OK: area page 'Things to Do: Camping: Open Camping-Walk/Float/Backpack(no Deer/Turkey) | Designated Camping Sites'; brochure 'Camping is allowed on or adjacent to all area parking lots'; the area map (Last Updated 1/6/2026) has five 'Camping site' symbols, each beside a 'Parking' symbol; GIS 27 points 534-538 'Primitive Camping Area'. Designated points at the lots, so it stays under the lot rule (Lick Creek). Rule 140 standard; no special-use-only rule, no Rule 101.

PIN fine: stored 40.42384,-92.94389 = GIS 538, on open grass 31 m N of gravel lot 789 (40.42356,-92.94383), a ~35 x 25 m gravel pad straight off gravel 324th Rd; a 23-ft rig reaches it. No ford or posted limit.

CLUSTERS (no split): the other four camping points are each a single small lot on a separate road - GIS 537 (40.41383,-92.95931) by lot 790 on the Route F/Geranium Trl side, 1.7 km SW; 536 (40.42680,-92.97386) by lot 1998 on Fern Trl, 2.6 km W; 535 (40.42195,-92.98697) by lot 1997 at the west boundary, 3.7 km W; 534 (40.40266,-92.94642) by lot 1999 off 323rd Rd, 2.4 km S. None is more than a single small lot, so none qualifies for a split, and none is plainly the main camp.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. The ponds (Pond 1-5 on the map) are small fishing ponds, under the ~5-acre pond line.
HORSES: brochure 'Bicycles and horses allowed on public roadways' - no horse camp.
